items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Well sometimes it sounds like you're using lip trills like T-Garden would.

ctx.x: Yeah. But now, but now I use a little lip and I just can shake it like this and I can enrich my tone. Just shake it like that.
Well sometimes it sounds like you're using lip trills like T-Garden would.
Well I do, I use a lot of, I'd say about sixty, seventy percent of my working jazz is lip trills. Yeah, lip trills. I use a lot of lip trills.
